# Sawtooth ridges -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `ideas_test.mjs sawtooth`; no library function exists for this texture.

Ridges run along X and repeat along +Y. Each layer is a solid strip of 0.45mm-spaced beads (serpentine, F1200, e/d 0.0374); layer k is (1 - (k-1)/n) of the pitch wide. Asymmetric patches keep the strip pinned to the ridge's -Y edge, so that face is vertical and the slope descends toward +Y. Patches are printed layer by layer across all ridges.

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=65, printed first. Part fan on (`M106 S255`) after it, off at the end. Textures occupy x 19-96, y 24-58. `verifyLayout` (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

| id | position (x0, y0) | parameters | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | 19.0, 24.0 | 6 ridges x 30mm along X, pitch 2, 5 layers (1.0mm) | asymmetric, fine: 2mm pitch, 1.0mm tall |
| S2 | 64.0, 24.0 | 4 ridges x 30mm along X, pitch 3, 8 layers (1.6mm) | asymmetric, coarse: 3mm pitch, 1.6mm tall |
| S3 | 19.0, 44.0 | 4 ridges x 30mm along X, pitch 3, 8 layers (1.6mm) | SYMMETRIC control for S2 (same pitch and height) |
| S4 | 64.0, 44.0 | 3 ridges x 30mm along X, pitch 4, 5 layers (1.0mm) | asymmetric, shallow: 4mm pitch, 1.0mm tall |

**What to look for**: Stroke S1/S2/S4 along +Y (down the slopes) and -Y (into the steep faces): is the direction obvious? Compare S2 with S3, which has the same size but no direction. Did the vertical face stay vertical or slump?

Totals: 2506 G-code lines, 112 retractions, 473.7 mm commanded filament.
